data.one_liner: Dynamically change app icons and iOS app icon batch numbers at runtime.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to programmatically change their launcher icons on both Android and iOS platforms. Additionally supports setting application icon badge numbers on iOS.
use_when: Your app needs to let users choose alternative launcher icons from within the app settings.
You need to manage dynamic branding or seasonal app icon updates.
avoid_when: You are unable to perform the necessary native configuration steps in AndroidManifest.xml and iOS Info.plist.
You only require a standard static app icon.
strengths: Supports both Android activity-aliases and iOS alternative icons.
Provides helper methods for checking support, getting current icon, and setting iOS badge numbers.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of Android activity-aliases and iOS plist or asset catalogs.
Android icon changes typically wait until the app is closed/removed from recents unless blacklists apply.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring AndroidManifest.xml activity-aliases and iOS Info.plist alternate icons dictionary or asset catalogs.
